english: Since I'm here, can I watch with you?
Marimo, doesn't move.\nThat's just how it is...
S-so then, its name?\nWhat's its name?
If you care about it so much,\nshouldn't it have a name?
Marimo can't talk.\nI don't know if it'd be happy with a name.
Me?\nIt'd definitely be better if you named it yourself.
Like this, no name is fine.
L-let's name it, since we're at it.
If I think of a good name, I'll let you know.
(I hope I can think of a good name...)
Um... about the name the other day...
Yeah, I had a question about naming it.\nIs it a boy? A girl?
So the name can't be gendered,\nthen.
No gender...\nso anything's fine, I think...
But until now, no name.\nNo need to force it.
Even without a name...\nit can live happily...
Don't say that.\nI'm sure calling its name would be more fun.
If I call its name...\nwould it be happy...?
It'll be fine.\nYou care about it so much,\nlet's give it a good name.
I-it's nothing... I didn't do much.
You brought Rimo.\nHas it been growing well since then?
(Bigger...?\nI can't see any change at all)
If you're not careful,\nits shape breaks easily...
But since it got a name,\nI feel like I cherish it more...
No, I didn't...\nIt's because you raised it with such care, Nine.
Do you like animals besides\nmarimo, too?
Frogs, lizards...\npeople dislike them, but I like them.
(Reptiles too... though\ntheir quiet nature is a bit like Nine...)
But maybe someday\nyou'll come to like them.
If you don't like them, that's fine...
They may look a little scary.\nBut they have cute sides...
If you get the chance.\nI'd like you to touch one and see...
Sometime, could you teach me\nabout the appeal of reptiles? ...Is that okay?
Then, of course... I'll introduce you to my friends.
I haven't even taught big sis.\nBig sis is bad with reptiles...
(She says it so happily.\nMaybe I want to learn more about reptiles too)
You look down.\nIs Rimo doing poorly since then?
Huh, ah, yes.\nBut then why do you look so down?
Lately, big sis is acting weird...
No...\nShe seems to have something to tell me.\nBut she says nothing...
When she looks at me, she seems lonely,\nor sad... like she's hurting.
But seeing big sis like that...\nit hurts.
Then I won't know\nwhen big sis will get better.
If I'm the cause... I should fix it.
You've been so wrapped up in taking care of Rimo.\nHaven't you gotten a little obsessed?
Lately I've been spending more time playing with Rimo.\nSis started acting weird around then, too...
Maybe.\nBut if you talk to her, I'm sure she'll understand.
You've been worrying about that this whole time?
(She's been suffering alone, where nobody could see...)
If anything else comes up, I'll hear you out,\nso cheer up, okay?
R-really?\nAny guy would do the same.
I want you to listen to me again sometime.\n...Please.
Did you make up with Tesla since then?
Then answer me when I talk to you.
Oh, that's right!\nTell me about reptiles.\nI still haven't heard your stories.
Thank you.\nYour concern makes me happy.
But today... I can't.\nSome other time...
Did I do something...?\nMaybe she hates me now...
Nain!?\nWhy'd you call me out here?
Figured out why Sis is acting weird.
You talking to me... being near me...\nShe didn't like it.
Sis worries too much. It's not your fault.\n...Don't mind it.
I promised... to tell you about reptiles.
But Sis...\nmaking that face... I hate it.
She's probably lonely.\nShe might think I stole you from her.
So you should clear up\nthe misunderstanding.
Just tell her straight\nthere's nothing to worry about.
Yes, I'm sure it'll get through to her.
I'm not sure... I can say it right.
As long as you feel that way, it'll be fine. I promise.
I hope Nain's okay.\nShe's not good with words, so hopefully she manages...
Sorry for calling you out.\nThanks for coming.
Just like you said.\nWe talked it out, and it's resolved.
She still seems bothered by something.\nBut...
It was nothing.\nI barely did anything.\nI'm glad you two made up, though.
I was... only thinking of myself.\nSorry for being cold to you.
About animals, and reptiles...\nI promised, so...
I want to know more... about you, too.
You're a strange person.\nInteresting... Is that bad?
It's not bad, but...\nWhat do you mean by that?
I want to know more... That's all.
If you knew everything...\nSomething scary might happen, you know?
...Okay. Next time... my friend... the frog.\nI'll bring him...
(She wants to know about me, huh...\nNain's quiet, but she's surprisingly forward.)
Nain!?\nThat outfit...\nWeren't we just going to talk?
N-no, not at all.\nIf anything, it's cute.
Rimo and the frog came too.
...Confirming a sharp rise in body temperature and heart rate.
My body... is hot. My heart's pounding...
Huh? Are you feeling sick?\nAre you okay...?
I brought cake... you should eat it.
She taught me... people like it when you do this.
No, not at all. I-it makes me happy, but...\nTesla's going to be mad if you do this, you know?
...No problem. I talked to her properly...
Guess it was all a dream after all...\nThings never go that smoothly, huh.
